description.value: Tokyo Wagyu Works is a fast-casual Japanese restaurant in North Vancouver's Lonsdale Quay area specializing in rare A5 Sendai Wagyu from Miyagi, Japan. The menu centres on wagyu rice bowls, udon, curry, and sushi, offering both premium sit-down and quick-order takeout formats. It's a notable stop for cyclists exploring the North Shore waterfront, offering a substantial hot meal close to the Lonsdale Quay SeaBus terminal.
